note: MIC 8-unit clearance vs canvas width: two signal arcs per side plus the head need about 46 units of width (2 x (outer arc 4 + gap 8 + inner arc 3 + gap 8)) before the head itself, and SOLO48 is 40 wide at most; concentric arcs need an outer radius of 23 or more. The uploaded attempt has the wide rounded-rectangle head and one arc per side.
